  "memo":"R03 holds: the Romanian IP differs from the US card issuing country and AVS failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no other rule holds, no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles this order. The applicable evidence row is §6.6(b), but the failed required id_check now decides it under §5.3(b). Recommend decline; escalation is prohibited without Linkage. Travel is a plausible benign explanation for the geography, but it does not override the failed check. The order has not shipped, so decline voids and refunds it and blocks the account. No further check is needed."
